rows.en: Are you a Kamen Rider too!?
That's a Kamen Rider. Kamen Rider Black RX, if I remember right.
I'll save you right now!!
Ugh...
A Kamen Rider...? So you're one of our comrades as well.
That's a Kamen Rider. Kamen Rider Black RX, if I remember right.
00, commencing rescue operation!!
Ugh...
A Kamen Rider...? I see. So you're one of our comrades too.
That's a Kamen Rider. Kamen Rider Black RX, if I remember right.
Target confirmed. Commencing rescue!
Ugh...
Are you a Kamen Rider too!?
That's a Kamen Rider. Kamen Rider Black RX, if I remember right.
Are you all right!? Hang on!! I'll save you right now!!
Aaah!!
A Kamen Rider, you say!? Then that makes you one of our comrades, right?
That's a Kamen Rider. Kamen Rider Black RX, if I remember right.
All right, hang on! I'll get you out of there in no time!!
Aaah!!
What? A barrier!?
Don't... come near so carelessly... A powerful energy field has been put up here...
I can't believe it... I was pulled into this world and, to my shame, captured by the enemy.
Damn! Isn't there anything we can do...!!
Dammit! Can't we do somethin' about this...!!
A barrier, huh!? Pullin' some annoying crap like that!
...Isn't there anything we can do?
...Isn't there anything we can do?
...Is there no way to break it?
...Is there no way to break it?
...We have to break through this barrier somehow.
Damn! A barrier! Ain't there some way to bust through it?
But it's all right... Don't worry.
But, RX, at this rate...
But we can't just leave you like this.
But still, it's rough on me too, not bein' able to do a thing!!
But at this rate...
But if this keeps up...
But at this rate, you'll only wear yourself down.
But at this rate, you'll only wear yourself down.
But if this keeps up...
But we can't just leave you here!
That's right...! There's something I have to tell you all.
To my shame, I lost consciousness, and the enemy captured me. And now look at me...
That's right.
Until just a moment ago, Kamen Rider 1 and Kamen Rider 2 were here, frozen in ice.
Whaat!?
What!?
Whaddya say!?
What!?
What!?
What!?
What!?
What did you say!?
What!?
But they carried them off.
I want to save them. But in my current state...
Do you know where they were taken!?
Still... when you say they took 'em, took 'em where?
Where'd those creeps haul 'em off to?
RX, do you have any idea where Rider 1 and Rider 2 were taken?
Where in the world could they have taken them...
Rider 1 and Rider 2, frozen in ice... Where could they have taken them...?
Rider 1 and Rider 2, frozen in ice... Where could they have taken them...?
Rider 1 and Rider 2, frozen in ice... Where could they have been taken...?
Rider 1 and Rider 2, frozen in ice... Where could they have taken them...?
From what the enemy was saying... I believe they mentioned the "Hideout Cube."
Huh? Hideout Cube...? So it was a different Cube after all...
I thought I'd be the next one they took away, but...
The O has set his sights on the "King Stone" inside my body.
The King Stone!?
The King Stone!?
The King Stone!?
The King Stone!?
The King Stone!?
The King Stone!?
The King Stone!?
The King Stone!?
The King Stone!?
The King Stone is the power of miracles. It must never, ever fall into enemy hands...

notes.note: Party-leader branches: each leader gets reaction / explainer / rescue attempt / repelled. Extractor labels every branch 'Zero', which is wrong. Inferred by voice and the 0252 roll-call order: 0.41 Nu Gundam (from story_037), 0.45 Zeta Gundam (anata), 0.49 00, 0.53 Wing Zero, 0.57 Mebius (polite), 0.61 Zero. Rider branches (OOO, W, Den-O Sword Form) are in story_037 (0.32-0.40). Identical source lines kept identical in English.
Explainer line (no speaker) said by a party member who knows of RX; repeated per branch (0.50/0.54/0.58/0.62).
Wing Zero (Heero) 'target kakunin, kyuushutsu suru': terse mission phrasing.
'Ore to shita koto ga' (unlike me / I can't believe I...) rendered 'I can't believe it...'.

0.68-0.76 one line per leader; inferred order OOO, W (Shotaro), Den-O Sword Form (0.70, Momotaros' rough voice), Nu, Zeta, 00, Wing Zero, Mebius, Zero (0.76). Same order holds for 0.78-0.86, 0.91-0.99, 0.102-0.110, 0.115-0.123. Subject 'we' restored in 0.68/0.69/0.71/0.72/0.75.
Label 'Zero' is wrong: polite 'RX-san' line = OOO (first branch). Honorific dropped per style.
'Shoumou suru dake' read as RX being worn down by the field (he just said not to worry); subject 'you' restored. Alternative 'we'll just wear ourselves out' possible.
No speaker recovered; content (I lost consciousness and was captured) is RX's, likely an alternate RX line. 0.89 'That's right.' also unlabelled, taken as RX.
Label 'Zero' is wrong: first branch (OOO). 0.93 Momotaros 'nan da to o' = 'Whaddya say!?'; 0.98 Mebius polite 'nan desu tte' = 'What did you say!?'.
Label 'Zero' wrong: polite = OOO. 0.103 W (Shotaro), 0.104 Den-O Sword Form ('-yagatta' -> 'those creeps'). 0.109 polite with -san = Mebius.
Corner-bracketed name kept in quotes; glossary 'Hideout Cube'.
'King Stone' not in glossary; standard English name from Kamen Rider Black / Black RX. The O = Scirocco, 'his'.
'Kiseki no chikara' = 'the power of miracles', matching 0247#0.73 ('They say it creates the power of miracles').

report: 80/80. 0253 party-leader branches; extractor's 'Zero' labels wrong on most branch lines, speakers inferred from voice and branch order (see notes). Uncertain: 0.83/0.84 subject of 'wear down' (taken as RX); 0.88/0.89 unlabelled, taken as RX. Not in glossary: King Stone.
